logline: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 21 where Prudence revealed that the Dowager Duchess is dying from a mysterious illness; Juliana sets aside her aristocratic identity to sneak into Ashbury Manor under the guise of domestic help to save her.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Nervous, Warning)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
